criteria.comment: Engineering geometry tolerances, not manufactured dimensions or material calibration. .01 mm rigidity is checked against repeat construction and Float32 rigid round trips.

checks.name: monk/independent actual mesh ray and penetration controls
failures: Float32-scale 0.000001 mm contact: independent contact classifier mistook Float32 contact for a transverse crossing

detail.method: Synthetic closed indexed meshes exercise actual ray casting and contact classification; real shoe acceptance still uses final shoe triangles.

checks.name: monk/t=0.9/static/pin enters the actual selected strap hole

detail.method: Actual outer/inner boundary loops identify the selected opening. Pin end sections must fit both projected rims and exit below the inner ring; the separate full-mesh intersection gate checks the intervening shell.

detail.scope: Static display geometry support interval, not a manufacturing clearance or a stitched/load-bearing joint simulation.

checks.name: monk/t=0.9/static/actual pierced seats and static mounting posts

detail.design: This workbench's generic static mounting geometry; no inferred commercial hidden construction or opening mechanism.

checks.name: monk/t=0.9/static/actual static closure has no transverse interference
failures: monk-buckle-mount-0-0 / monk-buckle-frame-0: actual indexed meshes intersect transversely (0, 12)
monk-buckle-mount-0-1 / monk-buckle-frame-0: actual indexed meshes intersect transversely (0, 4)
monk-buckle-mount-1-0 / monk-buckle-frame-1: actual indexed meshes intersect transversely (0, 18)
monk-buckle-mount-1-1 / monk-buckle-frame-1: actual indexed meshes intersect transversely (0, 2)

detail.method: Bidirectional indexed-mesh edge/triangle intersections with a positive ray control for each actual target. Endpoint contacts within 1e-5 mm are excluded. Source edges are orthogonally projected and clipped to the actual target triangle footprint before applying the unchanged 2e-5 mm contact-plane tolerance; raw crossings and unclipped endpoint deviations remain explicit. Synthetic penetrations must still fail. Finite-mesh static contact check, not force, opening or wear simulation.

checks.name: required lanes produced the requested case and check matrix
failures: Lane C is incomplete or failed; a requestedLane label alone cannot accept the increment.

checks.name: producer source stayed unchanged during independent increment

limits: This increment covers the requested Canvas attachment field, Chelsea actual-mesh shoulder, and project-designed static Monk connection. Numeric acceptance remains separate from SOURCE/PUBLIC visual review.
Actual Canvas bore rays cover two canvas shells and metal; laces and the independent tongue are separate actual meshes, not a claim of empty space through the entire shoe.
The prescribed bend and static connection checks do not solve forces, opening mechanics, manufacturing tolerances or wearer fit.
